states.ELIGIBLE: All mandatory official rules are proven satisfied by verified student profile data.
states.NOT_ELIGIBLE: At least one mandatory official rule is proven failed (e.g. age exceeded, minimum qualification not met).
states.MORE_INFORMATION_NEEDED: A required student profile field is missing/unpopulated, preventing complete rule evaluation.
states.NOT_EVALUATED: Official rule is unavailable, corrupted, or unsupported by automated rule parser.
states.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Provisional match permitted only under explicit governance contract (never masks unresolved authoritative rules).

collapsePreventionRule.logic: If any rule evaluates to FAILED, the state is strictly NOT_ELIGIBLE, even if other profile fields are unpopulated. Missing fields only cause MORE_INFORMATION_NEEDED when no rules have failed.
